welcome.description: Continue your journey or choose a new adventure.

learning.title: Learn while having fun
learning.description: Courses, games and challenges to grow your math skills.

about.title: What is Mbuyamba Education?
about.tagline: An interactive learning platform that turns studying into an experience.
about.description: Mbuyamba Education brings together structured courses, interactive exercises, educational games and progress tracking in one place. A student learns a concept, practices it, plays to reinforce it, and watches their progress build over time.

level.title: Learn at your level
level.text: Paths organized by grade to move forward step by step and lock in the essentials.

play.title: Learn by playing too
play.text: Math becomes adventures, challenges and situations to solve, rather than a string of exercises.

progress.title: Understand your progress
progress.text: The student sees what they've started, what they've mastered, and what still needs work.

yamba.title: Never alone
yamba.text: Yamba guides, encourages and helps the student whenever they need it.

about.conclusion: At Mbuyamba, learning, practicing and playing are all part of the same adventure.

continuePlaying.heading: Continue playing
continuePlaying.message: Ready for a new challenge? Take it on and earn rewards!
